definitions.explanation: The act of cleaning dishes, or a person who washes dishes.

examples.japanese: {食器洗|しょっきあら}いをする。
{夕食|ゆうしょく}の{後|あと}の{食器洗|しょっきあら}いは{私|わたし}の{担当|たんとう}だ。
examples.english: Washing the dishes after dinner is my job.

examples.japanese: {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}を{買|か}ってから、{家事|かじ}が{楽|らく}になった。
examples.english: Since we bought a dishwasher, housework has become easier.

notes:
{食器洗|しょっきあら}い is a compound of {食器|しょっき} (dishes/tableware) + {洗|あら}い (washing). Refers to the act of washing dishes or a person who washes dishes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}いをする: to wash the dishes
- {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}: dishwasher (machine)
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}: dishwasher (common abbreviation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皿洗|さらあら}い: dish washing (slightly more casual, literally 'plate washing')
- {洗|あら}い{物|もの}: things to be washed (dishes, laundry)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese households, {食器洗|しょっきあら}い is one of the common {家事|かじ} (household chores). {食洗機|しょくせんき} (dishwashers) are becoming more popular but are still less common than in Western countries.
